user_input_zh: 即使很多同行采用，也要比较人工或简单工具，确认新增价值和完整成本。
use: User-selected learning takeaway, translated and lightly elaborated in the final reflection. No invented prior belief, independent student verification or personal fieldwork.
english_reflection: I would not treat peer adoption as enough to justify using an agent. I need to compare it with manual review and simpler tools at equivalent quality, including checking, correction and support costs. For me, the important judgment is whether the agent adds value over the best adequate alternative, not whether it looks more advanced. A faster first draft can still be a worse overall workflow.
